definitions.gloss: single color; monochrome; solid color; one color
definitions.explanation: Consisting of only one color, without patterns, gradients, or multiple hues.

examples.japanese: {単色|たんしょく}のTシャツが{欲|ほ}しい。
この{部屋|へや}は{単色|たんしょく}の{壁紙|かべがみ}でまとめてある。
examples.english: This room is done in a single-color wallpaper throughout.

examples.japanese: {単色|たんしょく}の{印刷|いんさつ}なら{費用|ひよう}を{抑|おさ}えることができる。
examples.english: If it's single-color printing, we can keep the costs down.

notes:
Composed of {単|たん} (single) + {色|しょく} (color). Used in fashion, design, printing, and art contexts. Can modify nouns with の: {単色|たんしょく}のデザイン (monochrome design).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単色|たんしょく}のデザイン — monochrome design
- {単色|たんしょく}{印刷|いんさつ} — single-color printing
- {単色|たんしょく}{刷|ず}り — single-color print
- {単色|たんしょく}{光|こう} — monochromatic light

SIMILAR WORDS:
- モノクロ — monochrome (loanword; often specifically means black and white)
- {無地|むじ} — plain, unpatterned (focuses on absence of pattern rather than having one color)
- {多色|たしょく} — multicolored (the opposite)
- {二色|にしょく} — two-colored, bicolor
